text:
maria: quick spike idea: run a 'sim-demote' pilot that marks prefixes as demoted but doesn't free memory. we collect hit/miss deltas and downstream latency to verify eviction heuristics.

tom: sounds useful. how is this different from earlier dry-run tooling?

maria: it's runtime, continuous, and tied to our promotion pipeline. dry-run was offline batch. sim-demote will run in-path and emit tagged metrics.

devops-bot: note: staging cluster for sim-demote is up at https://staging.ops (expires in 48h)

lee: tagging metrics is crucial. please ensure we add these labels: `cache.eviction_policy`, `eviction.mode` (sim|real), `pilot.id`. otherwise dashboards will mix signals.

maria: agreed. proposal for labels: `eviction.mode=simulated`, `pilot=sim-demote-2026-03`, `tenant_slice=rand(1pct)`.

asha: caution: billing/usage pipelines consume cache-miss metrics for chargeback. we must not leak simulated misses into billing. who owns the filter?

maria: ops/metrics team needs to add server-side filter. action: tom to add metric exclusion rule in ingestion.

tom: can do. plan: mark all sim metrics with `eviction.mode=simulated` and add exclusion rule to metrics ingestion (and to raw export for audits).

qa-bot: automated tests: please add a smoke test that verifies simulated metrics are tagged and not present in billing export.

lee: also need trace spans with the same label so distributed traces don't confuse SLO alerts. snippet: `span.setAttribute("eviction.mode", "simulated")`.

maria: rollout plan: 1) enable sim-demote per-shard in staging, 2) run 2h pilot collecting metrics, 3) replay a tiny subset through real demote path to exercise handoff, 4) if green, schedule limited promotion to 0.5% tenants.

asha: what metrics will we watch for auto-abort? propose: `sim_eviction_kv_miss_increase_pct > 5%`, `99th_latency_increase_pct > 8%`, `rehydration_error_rate > 0.05%`.

maria: +1. also add `lease.handback_failures` as a gate. if any handback failures > 0 for the replay group abort immediately.

tom: technical detail: how do we implement sim-demote atomicity? we should avoid race where a real demote overlaps with simulated state. suggestion: sim flag in prefix metadata that is read by the demote decision path; real demote still checks `prefix.generation` > X before deleting.

lee: ensure tests include concurrent real demote + sim-demote to catch races. add a fuzz test in the lease manager harness.

maria: documentation: will update runbook and the eviction RFC follow-up with the pilot checklist and metric names. will add PR template: `[sim-demote-canary]`.

devops-bot: reminder: tag PR with `[staging-run]` to auto-deploy the pilot config.

asha: communication: notify `perf-oncall` and `customer-success` with short blurb. CS will want copy for customers if we promote widely.

tom: timeline: aim for pilot Fri 03/26 10:00 UTC, owners: maria (owner), tom (metrics/ingest), lee (trace+tests), asha (product+CS contact).

maria: done. I'll create the follow-up doc and include the smoke test matrix and rollback steps (kill pilot, clear sim flags, rehydrate prefixes).

lee: one more: add `eviction.event_id` UUID so we can correlate sim->replay->real events across systems.

maria: good call. I'll add that to the trace/metric instrumentation.

tom: ack, starting ingestion rule draft.

asha: ack, prepping CS blurb.

qa-bot: lint results: tests referencing `eviction.mode` tag must use exact string match in assertions.

maria: thanks all. opening the RFC follow-up now and tagging the owners.
